items.generated_zh: 摘麦穗，用手搓揉吃里面的麦粒。
items.generated_en: Pick the wheat ears, rub them by hand, and eat the grains inside.

items.generated_zh: 人子是安息日的 主。
items.generated_en: The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.

items.generated_zh: 因为在天上的赏赐是大的。正如他们的祖先对待先知一样。
items.generated_en: Because the rewards in heaven are great, just as their ancestors treated the prophets.

items.generated_zh: 爱你们的敌人，对恨你们的人行善。
items.generated_en: Love your enemies and do good to those who hate you.
